item.text:
The coverage map uses the proposed ticket labels A–I; Storybloq IDs will be assigned after approval.

| Requirement or decision | Source | Coverage and acceptance evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Individual club accounts for about 80 members | Your instructions | **A:** individual login and access-control tests. **H:** staff account-provisioning guide. |
| Three courts; one-hour bookings | README | **D:** validate court IDs and hourly starts. **G:** display and book eligible slots. |
| Never double-book a court for a slot | README | **D:** database constraint and simultaneous-request tests. **H:** integrated acceptance evidence. |
| Book up to seven days ahead | Your instructions | **D:** enforce the inclusive rolling 168-hour boundary. **B/G:** expose every eligible slot, even across eight calendar dates. |
| At most two upcoming bookings per member | Your instructions | **E:** count active future bookings and enforce the limit under concurrent requests. **G:** explain quota failures. |
| Cancel until two hours before the start | README | **F:** allow cancellation at exactly two hours, reject below it, release slot and quota; boundary and race tests. **G:** cancellation interface. |
| Retain Django | Your instructions | **A–H:** Django authentication, server-rendered screens, persistence, and tests. |
| Staff-created accounts; no public signup | Delegated judgment | **A:** admin-only provisioning and password reset. **H:** operating instructions. |
| UTC initially; configurable club timezone | Delegated judgment | **D:** timezone-aware validation and daylight-saving tests. **B/G:** explicit timezone labels. **C:** owner inspects the display. |
| Members access only their own booking controls | Delegated judgment | **A/F/G:** authentication, ownership checks, CSRF protection, and authorization tests. Availability reveals no other member names. |
| Existing free-text booking ownership is preserved safely | Existing model; implementation safeguard | **A:** explicit account mapping; unresolved records block migration rather than silently losing or guessing ownership. |
| Usable empty, error, conflict, and cancellation states | Delegated judgment | **B/G:** accessible forms and feedback. **H:** keyboard walkthrough and integrated journey tests. |
| Staff can operate and recover the app | Delegated judgment | **H:** setup, timezone configuration, backup/restore procedure, and production configuration checklist. |
| Owner accepts the first version | Setup workflow | **C:** early interface inspection. **I:** final demonstration against the rules above, using **H** evidence. |
| Guest-booking payments | README: later scope | **Explicitly deferred.** No first-version implementation ticket. |

Public signup, notifications, recurring bookings, and public deployment execution are also excluded from this first version. Deployment hosting remains undecided and does not block the local implementation.

The plan is unchanged; setup remains unwritten.

Review not rerun: showing the coverage map changes no ticket's scope, dependencies or responsibilities.
